notableFeatures: A series of notches are carved into the blade, one for each kill.
The grip is worn smooth in one particular spot from long use.
It is perfectly balanced for throwing, even if not designed for it.
It makes a faint, almost inaudible whistling sound when swung.
The maker's mark is an unusual, unidentifiable symbol.
It never seems to get dirty or require cleaning.
It feels heavier than it looks, and strikes with surprising force.
Fine script rings the guard, too small to read without a lens.
A shallow groove channels blood away from the hand.
The edge shows a wave pattern like ripples on a pond.
A hairline crack forms a shape like a lightning bolt.
The pommel unscrews to reveal a tiny compartment.
Tiny bells on the tassel never make a sound.
A faded ribbon is tied beneath the guard.
There is a chip shaped like a crescent moon.
Every time you glance away, it lies at a slightly different angle.
The scabbard (if any) smells faintly of wintergreen.
A prayer is scratched into the inside of the guard.
The weapon grows cool in sunlight and warm at night.
When knocked, it answers with a hollow, echoing tone.
A bead of red enamel marks the balance point.
The haft has tally marks grouped in sevens.
The quillons depict birds taking flight.
A single hair is trapped beneath the lacquer.
The grip hides a sewn-in lock of someone’s hair.
Its reflection lags a heartbeat behind movements.
In rain, droplets avoid the edge and cling to the flat.
Runes only show when breathed upon.
A small dent perfectly fits the wielder’s thumb.
A faint ring appears around it during dawn light.

magicalProperties.name: Scorching
magicalProperties.description: Deals an extra 1d4 fire damage on a hit.

magicalProperties.name: Icing
magicalProperties.description: Deals an extra 1d4 cold damage on a hit.

magicalProperties.name: Shocking
magicalProperties.description: Deals an extra 1d4 lightning damage on a hit.

magicalProperties.name: Venomous
magicalProperties.description: Deals an extra 1d4 poison damage on a hit.

magicalProperties.name: Steadfast
magicalProperties.description: Grants the wielder advantage on saves against being frightened.

magicalProperties.name: Returning
magicalProperties.description: If thrown, the weapon returns to the wielder's hand at the end of the turn.

magicalProperties.name: Keen
magicalProperties.description: This weapon scores a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

magicalProperties.name: Radiant
magicalProperties.description: Deals an extra 1d4 radiant damage; glows softly in darkness.

magicalProperties.name: Necrotic
magicalProperties.description: Deals an extra 1d4 necrotic damage; kills small vermin on contact.

magicalProperties.name: Thunderclap
magicalProperties.description: On a critical hit, emits a thunderous boom audible 300 ft.

magicalProperties.name: Frostbrand
magicalProperties.description: Extinguishes nonmagical flames within 10 ft when drawn.

magicalProperties.name: Flame Tongue
magicalProperties.description: As a bonus action, ignite the blade for 1 minute, shedding bright light.

magicalProperties.name: Binding
magicalProperties.description: On a hit, target’s movement is reduced by 10 ft until end of its next turn.

magicalProperties.name: Wounding
magicalProperties.description: Critical hits cause lingering bleeds that resist mundane healing.

magicalProperties.name: Bane of Beasts
magicalProperties.description: Deals +1d4 damage versus beasts; advantage on tracking checks.

magicalProperties.name: Bane of Undead
magicalProperties.description: On hit, undead must succeed a save or be turned for 1 round.

magicalProperties.name: Spellguard
magicalProperties.description: Wielder gains +1 to saves versus spells while holding the weapon.

magicalProperties.name: Featherlight
magicalProperties.description: Counts as 5 lb lighter for encumbrance and ignores disadvantage in water.

magicalProperties.name: Phase-Step
magicalProperties.description: Once per short rest, the wielder can step through an adjacent wall 5 ft.

magicalProperties.name: Sentinel
magicalProperties.description: Opportunity attacks with this weapon have advantage.

magicalProperties.name: Vorpal Edge
magicalProperties.description: On a natural 20, sever a vital part on a helpless or stunned foe.

magicalProperties.name: Whispersteel
magicalProperties.description: Attacks make no sound; advantage on Stealth checks to hide after attacking.

magicalProperties.name: Sapping
magicalProperties.description: On hit, target takes a −1 penalty to its next attack roll (once per round).

magicalProperties.name: Guiding
magicalProperties.description: On hit, the next attack against that target before your next turn has advantage.

magicalProperties.name: Sunbound
magicalProperties.description: Deals radiant damage to fiends and undead; sheds sunlight in a 10-ft radius at will.

magicalProperties.name: Moonsong
magicalProperties.description: Sings softly under moonlight; grants +1 to Insight checks at night.

magicalProperties.name: Stormcall
magicalProperties.description: While outdoors, once per day call a bolt of lightning (3d6) on a struck target.

magicalProperties.name: Gravitic
magicalProperties.description: Can anchor itself; cannot be disarmed while anchored (bonus action to toggle).

magicalProperties.name: Echoing
magicalProperties.description: Once per short rest, repeat your last attack roll against the same target.

magicalProperties.name: True North
magicalProperties.description: Always points toward a chosen place when held flat.
